thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: SEV2 — ZenMode (tenant: zenmode-prod) private VPC egress failures. Symptoms: 502/504 client errors, NLB target health flapping, DNS falling back to public. Paging oncall. Runbook: https://redwood.incidents/runbooks/privnet-egress
sarah (oncall): Taking this. Can someone confirm what started at ~06:10 UTC? Customer reports bulk ingestion failures.
kevin (eng-sre): Seeing NLB target group tg-zn-prod go Unhealthy->Healthy rapidly. Healthcheck path /health failing with connection reset from agent.
james (netops): I see a recent infra change at 06:09 — privnet-proxy-sg egress rule replaced by template that removed ephemeral range. NLB HC uses ephemeral source ports to reach agents.
lucy (support): Confirmed from ZenMode: ~40% of requests to embeddings API failing since 06:12. They've enabled hosted fallback for some jobs.
customer-eng: @sarah are we routing them to Dedicated pool now? Customer wants ETA and whether we can keep minimal disruption.
sarah (oncall): Quick mitigation plan: 1) Re-add ephemeral egress SG rule 2) Shift traffic weight 30% -> dedicated (ded-zen-1) temporarily 3) Monitor. Executing SG rollback now.
kevin (eng-sre): Logs from agent around failures:
```
06:11:52 [ERROR] healthcheck failed: read tcp 10.1.5.32:9000->10.2.3.45:52344: connection reset by peer
06:12:03 [WARN] high latency on /embeddings - timeout
```
james (netops): Running rollback command to restore egress range: `aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0abcd1234 --protocol tcp --port 32768-65535 --cidr 10.0.0.0/8`
kevin (eng-sre): Command result: SUCCESS. NLB target health showing steady Healthy after ~30s.
incident-bot: Incident created: 7098765432. Playbook: privnet-egress-sg-rollback. Channel: #incidents. Doc: https://redwood.incidents/7098765432
james (netops): Also found DNS weight pointing heavily to public edge due to previous failover. Flipping weighted record to 90% private -> 10% public to reduce cross-noise.
sarah (oncall): Applied traffic weight change. Error rate for zenmode-prod dropped from 42% -> 9% within 3 minutes. Continuing to observe for 15m. :eyes:
kevin (eng-sre): Short-term recommendation: add a lightweight health endpoint `/_internal/hc` that immediately returns 200 to avoid false negatives on NLB checks. Filing ENG-13579 for persistent fix.
lucy (support): Customer notified: support message sent, they acknowledged and will run canary ingestion to validate.
james (netops): Plan: keep SG rollback in place for 1h, then lock down to only NLB subnet sources. Root cause candidate: automation template removed ephemeral egress during a change — will follow up in RCA.
sarah (oncall): Handoff to night oncall @kevin at 07:00 UTC. I'll write timeline and immediate actions in the incident doc.
kevin (eng-sre): Taking over. I'll keep dedicated pool weighting and 15m of aggressive monitoring. Ping me if 504s return. :thumbsup:
customer-eng: Customer reports canary looks good so far; they'll reconvene in 60m if stable. Thanks team.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: 07:08 UTC — service restored to ~99.8% for zenmode-prod, mitigations in place. ETA for full RCA: 24-48h. Incident channel locked to responders only.
